deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for service `text-gen` -> image: rwinf/text-gen:v2.1 (canary 5%). Change window: 22:00-23:30 UTC. Runbooks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-abort and https://redwood.internal/runbooks/unwind-procedures :rocket:
alex (release-lead): Copying abort criteria into thread so it's obvious: error-rate spike >1.5% sustained for 3m, p99 latency >2s for 5m, downstream 5xx >0.5%, or customer-facing regressions reported in #support. If any of these hit, we consider abort.
jamal (oncall): Watching SLO dashboard now. I'll call abort if error-rate >1.5% for 3m and I'm not getting a fast mitigation. :eyes:
maria (infra): If we abort we should pin the previous image and scale down canary. Pin command is in the runbook but FYI: `./deploy pin --service text-gen --image rwinf/text-gen:v2.0 --reason "abort v2.1"`
chris (sre): Adding quick rollback commands here for ops visibility:
```
# force immediate rollback to stable
deployctl rollback --service text-gen --target-image rwinf/text-gen:v2.0 --no-promote
# unpin if needed
deployctl unpin --service text-gen --force
```
alex (release-lead): Also note the escape-hatch: if the canary fails but master is healthy, we can pause and run a targeted hotfix rather than full rollback. Criteria for pause: noisy logs but <0.5% user impact.
jamal (oncall): Seeing slightly elevated latency at the canary start (+150ms). p95 is fine. Keeping an eye. If p99 crosses 2s I'll trigger the abort flow and notify ops.
maria (infra): Deploy bot will auto-escalate at 1.5% error-rate. Confirmed. If you need a manual choke point use `kubectl scale --replicas=0 deploy/text-gen-canary` (ops-only).
deploy-bot: Canary progressed to 25% at 2351234590. Monitoring metrics: cpu ok, errors 0.4%, p99 1.1s. Auto-watchers: enabled.
chris (sre): Reminder: gather debug bundle before rollback. Command: `rz collect --service text-gen --since 5m --out /tmp/textgen-bundle.tar.gz`
alex (release-lead): If abort happens, we want a short public note in release notes: "Rollback v2.1 due to latency regression in canary; investigating root cause." Keep language minimal.
jamal (oncall): OK holding. If I call abort I'll post here and ping @maria and @chris.
maria (infra): If abort confirmed, I'll run the pin + scale commands and leave a short ops note in the runbook checklist.
alex (release-lead): Thanks team. If we get to rollback, follow postmortem template linked in runbook.
deploy-bot: Canary complete: promote to 75% at 2351234610. No abort triggered. Will proceed to full rollout at 23:10 UTC unless a showstopper occurs. :white_check_mark:
